about: The Witchwood's interface (docs/packs/format.md, 'UI theme'): the haunted forest of Gilneas under a full moon — dark panels of mossy, rain-soaked pine wood with tarnished moonlit-silver rims, buttons of deep witchwood green that glow pumpkin orange under the mouse like a carved lantern, pale parchment text of the hunters' bounty notices, moonlit silver for headings, blood red for danger and a sickly witch-green for confirmations, will-o'-wisps drifting up through the mist over the menu; the title in Classic's Cinzel Decorative, in silver.
